data.gender_notes: Anniken is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Norse name Anne, meaning grace or mercy. The suffix -ken may indicate a diminutive or a beloved one. The name Anniken carries the meaning “Graceful, loving” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Anniken usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, loving and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anniken total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
